resolutionMode: orchestrator-direct-amend (single round, all consensus + high findings applied)

findings.description: Schema required `command: string`, rejecting HTTP-only entries like the repo's `paper` server.
findings.resolution: Schema is now a `z.union([StdioEntry, HttpEntry]).passthrough()` — stdio requires `command`, http requires `url`. Acceptance test fixtures use the repo's actual HTTP shape.
Added 4th acceptance test (d) exercising `resumeThreadId` path and asserting `client.resumeThread` receives merged mcpServers.

findings.description: Fixtures should be HTTP, matching repo's `.mcp.json`.
findings.resolution: All four acceptance test fixtures now use `{ type: 'http', url: 'http://127.0.0.1:29979/mcp' }` — the actual paper shape.

findings.description: AGENTS.md says mocked tests don't count as acceptance; tension must be acknowledged.
findings.resolution: Out of Scope explicitly documents the AGENTS.md policy mismatch and flags integration-test coverage extension as an acknowledged follow-up.

findings.description: Transport security citation pointed at `daemon/CLAUDE.md` instead of main `packages/happy-cli/CLAUDE.md`.
findings.resolution: Citation corrected to `packages/happy-cli/CLAUDE.md:282-310` with explicit note about the prior misattribution.

findings.description: Passthrough policy for Codex-supported extras (cwd, env_vars, http_headers, ...) needed explicit decision.
findings.resolution: Technical Constraints + Implementation Strategy now explicitly call out `.passthrough()` for forward-compat with Codex-supported extras; helper unit test added for `http_headers`/`bearer_token_env_var` passthrough.
Acceptance test (a) now explicitly asserts `type` is stripped on the merged entry; helper unit test for HTTP entry also asserts `type` is stripped.

findings.description: cwdAtStart consistency: load and call-sites should use the same captured cwd.
findings.resolution: Implementation Strategy now captures `cwdAtStart` once and uses it for the loader AND the `cwd:` args of both `resumeExistingThread` and `client.startThread`.
Preliminary Story Decomposition prefaced with explicit note that slices are conceptual ordering, not separate commits — everything lands in one atomic commit per Acceptance Criterion 9.

findings.resolution: Plan now explicitly says 'delivered 2026-05-13' with no `<sha>` placeholder.
